Chapter 974  Chapter 29: Domineering (Please Subscribe)

In the depths of Lin Yuan's mind, a 'brand new' Myriad Realms Gate stood erect.

Compared to before stepping into the twelfth level, there is no difference in size of this Myriad Realms Gate now.

However, in terms of details, it has been greatly enriched, ancient mottled patterns emerged, and an endless mysterious aura, transcending above the timeline, permeated.

"This Myriad Realms Gate now probably resembles the true Myriad Realms Gate more closely."

Ripples stirred in Lin Yuan's heart as he thought to himself.

At this moment, this Myriad Realms Gate gave him a feeling of transcending and dominating everything.

The reason for such a change is because Lin Yuan's previous life level was too low, so the projection of Myriad Realms Gate he bore was incomplete.

Now, with the advancement to the twelfth level, his life level has also transformed, allowing him to bear more information about the true Myriad Realms Gate.

"The Myriad Realms Gate is not within the timeline, perhaps even those Perfect Time Beings of the thirteenth level, who peep into numerous timelines of the past and future, are also unable to discover it."

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

Being on the thirteenth level, Time Beings already possess some characteristics of Perfect Time Beings, able to observe numerous timelines.

For Time Beings of the thirteenth level, basically nothing remains a secret; as long as they wish, they can completely trace back to the source through the timeline.

But the Myriad Realms Gate? Beyond all timelines, those Time Beings of the thirteenth level, even if they come into Lin Yuan's mind and face this Myriad Realms Gate, would not detect a trace.

Lin Yuan can see and feel the aura of the Myriad Realms Gate because he is the owner of the Myriad Realms Gate.

Apart from Lin Yuan, even the powerful Time Beings cannot glimpse any trace of the Myriad Realms Gate.

"Let's see what's different than before."

Lin Yuan extended a strand of consciousness into the Myriad Realms Gate, beginning to receive the information inside anew.

The changes in the details of the Myriad Realms Gate are of less concern to Lin Yuan; what's crucial now is what new functions the Myriad Realms Gate possesses.

Humming sounds.

A large amount of information merged into Lin Yuan's consciousness.

With the enhancement of Lin Yuan's life essence, he can accommodate more of the real Myriad Realms Gate and naturally, he can also harness more of the Myriad Realms Gate's abilities.

After a long while.

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes, his expression thoughtful.

"So that's how it is."

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan's face.

After receiving the new information from the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan roughly understood the new capabilities of the current Myriad Realms Gate.

Firstly, the many worlds Lin Yuan descended to through the Myriad Realms Gate have had their coordinates completely locked.

In the future, if Lin Yuan descends again, he won't need to pay the cost of World-Breaking Origin Force, he could directly descend.

And after descending, only a fraction of his mind is needed, without the necessity of his entire spirit fully entering.

In simple terms, in the future when Lin Yuan traverses and descends into other dimensional worlds, there's no need to settle his true body; the act of descending into the traversed worlds will be more akin to embodying an avatar, allowing action simultaneously with his true self.

"This is indeed nice."

Lin Yuan slightly nodded, at least later on, there won't be interruptions in traversing.

Before breaking through to the twelfth level, he didn't dare to traverse to source worlds because he worried about any emergency occurring to his true body during the traversal, necessitating his immediate return.

The time flow speed between the source world and the Main Universe is too vast, it's easy for issues to arise without careful attention.

"Source world..."

Lin Yuan looked towards the thirty-three world coordinates deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

After Lin Yuan's life essence stepped into the twelfth level, the thirty-three source world coordinates became clear again, now more than a dozen.

...

"World-Breaking Origin Force!"

The second ability that emerged in Lin Yuan's mind regarding the Myriad Realms Gate.surface

That is the utilization of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Previously, Lin Yuan's methods of utilizing World-Breaking Origin Force were just a few.

One is for traversing; the second is to bring items from the Main Universe into the traversed worlds, or to bring items from the traversed worlds into the Main Universe.

But now... the uses of World-Breaking Origin Force have multiplied.

For example, if Lin Yuan chooses to traverse to source worlds in the form of descending consciousness,

during weaker periods, he can leverage World-Breaking Origin Force to rapidly recover strength; theoretically, as long as there is enough World-Breaking Origin Force, he can instantly restore full strength and replicate this physical body from the Main Universe into that source world.

It should be known, Lin Yuan's physical body contains countless essences, replicating it? It's not just about resources.

But the World-Breaking Origin Force of the Myriad Realms Gate can replicate it perfectly.

In fact, it's not just Lin Yuan's physical body, any item, arms or precious treasures, as long as Lin Yuan thoroughly understands and comprehends them, can be replicated.

It's only a matter of how much World-Breaking Origin Force is needed.

"This ability... truly terrifying." Lin Yuan exclaimed in his heart.

Replicating all things tangible and intangible in this world? What kind of heaven-defying method is this?

If one day, Lin Yuan comprehensively understands the Chaos Void, could he also use World-Breaking Origin Force to replicate a Chaos Void?

Beyond replicating abilities, World-Breaking Origin Force can also be used for escape, attack, etc., can be described as an all-powerful source force.

"With the current strength of my physical body, to perfectly replicate it using World-Breaking Origin Force, it would approximately require 2,733,000 strands of World-Breaking Origin Force...."

Lin Yuan slightly felt his own condition, the corners of his mouth twitching slightly.

2,733,000 strands of World-Breaking Origin Force actually isn't much; according to an accumulation speed of 90 days per strand, it would take roughly 700,000 years.

"There's no necessity to directly replicate the physical body."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head; the main effect of traversing and descending into other worlds is to comprehend the unique rules of those dimensional worlds, to explore the cultivation paths of those dimensional worlds.
